{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, removing currency symbols and commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace('[,$]', '', regex=True).astype(float)

# Check for refunds and calculate net revenue
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
net_revenue = sales[~(sales['status'] == 'refunded')]['revenue'].sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales.duplicated().sum()

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales.isnull().sum()

# Check value counts for key columns
channel_counts = sales['channel'].value_counts()
customer_segment_counts = sales['customer_segment'].value_counts()
converted_counts = sales['converted'].value_counts()

# Show the results
(net_revenue, refunded_orders.shape[0], duplicates, missing_values, channel_counts, customer_segment_counts, converted_counts)"}
